establishedFindings.finding: Exact page request timeout is emitted when a private SDK pending request has no matching MessagePort response within5000ms. It is distinct from page-script-timeout5000ms, project-view-local-startup-timeout10000ms and the host liveness3000ms failure.

Actual start sequentially awaits riffoid.readFile(docs/series.json), parses/render, then awaits riffoid.subscribe. The one catch replaces the entire app with Load error plus error.message. Either of these two calls can produce the observed message; this text alone does not identify which call. The119B declared file exists and its bytes/SHA match the actual R2 write.

Host connects using exact sourceWindow/null origin/nonce, child replies ready, host transfers exactly one port, child binds/starts the port before project install. Broker starts port before child start. Seeing project JS reach a riffoid request establishes useful bootstrap progress; it does not prove all later port delivery/lifecycle transitions.

Every file read serially awaits initial authorization, reads frozen in-memory asset, then final authorization before delivery. Each authorization independently allows10000ms HTTP. Subscribe adds an artifact-index GET also allowing10000ms between the two authorization reads. These legal host paths can exceed the child5000ms pending timeout without a host HTTP timeout or rejection. Authorization itself reconstructs the current canonical package through Gateway/Workspace and rechecks Catalog/invitation.

Project selection enters simulation regardless of selected top-level Model panel. Declared pages can enter before Model is visible; top-level layout merely hides the main view. ProjectPages.setActive is wired to the Model internal overview/artifact tab. First clicking Model need not be the first project JS or SDK execution.

SDK responses require matching request id; a timed-out pending entry is removed and a late response is ignored. Close/generation guards drop stale host results. A page-handled SDK exception is not an unhandledrejection, so the project may show its own Load error while bootstrap has already announced installed and host liveness still succeeds.
